rules.description: Donor (person making the LPA) must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 18 years old to make a lasting power of attorney

rules.description: Donor must have mental capacity to make their own decisions
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have mental capacity (the ability to make your own decisions) when you make your LPA

rules.description: All attorneys must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: Your attorney needs to be 18 or over

rules.description: Attorney must have mental capacity to make their own decisions
rules.reason_if_failed: You must appoint someone who has the mental capacity to make their own decisions

rules.description: For property and financial affairs LPA, attorney cannot be bankrupt or subject to DRO
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot choose someone who is subject to a Debt Relief Order or someone who is bankrupt if you're making a lasting power of attorney for property and financial affairs

rules.description: LPA is legally binding only in England and Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This LPA will be legally binding only in England and Wales. Use a different service for Scotland or Northern Ireland.

rules.description: Must have a certificate provider who confirms you're making the LPA by choice
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a certificate provider to confirm you're making the LPA by choice and you understand what you're doing

explanation_template: LPA eligibility: {outcome}. Remember, you can make one or both types of LPA (health & welfare, property & financial affairs).

edge_cases.description: Donor loses mental capacity during the application process
edge_cases.action: Application cannot proceed. If LPA is not yet registered, it cannot be completed. Refer to Court of Protection for deputyship instead.

edge_cases.description: Attorney becomes bankrupt or subject to DRO after appointment (property & financial affairs LPA only)
edge_cases.action: Property & financial affairs LPA will end automatically. If replacement attorneys exist, they will take over. Otherwise, LPA ends.

edge_cases.description: Attorney loses mental capacity after being appointed
edge_cases.action: Attorney can no longer act. If replacement attorneys exist or other attorneys can act jointly and severally, LPA continues. Otherwise, LPA may end.

edge_cases.description: People to notify raise objections during 3-week notification period
edge_cases.action: OPG will investigate concerns. Registration may be delayed or refused. Court of Protection may need to make a decision.

edge_cases.description: Attorney divorces donor or ends civil partnership (if attorney is spouse/partner)
edge_cases.action: Attorney's appointment ends automatically. If replacement attorneys exist or other attorneys can act jointly and severally, LPA continues.

edge_cases.description: Concerns about undue influence or coercion
edge_cases.action: Certificate provider should not sign. If already registered, report to OPG. May require Court of Protection involvement.

edge_cases.description: Attorney has potential conflict of interest with donor's affairs
edge_cases.action: Attorney must act in donor's best interests. If serious conflict, may need to remove attorney or involve Court of Protection.
